state.decision: Wiring the Library's virtual folders and Import folder into the Editor's Library panel (Figma B13, plan row 11.122), asked BEFORE coding (claude, 26 Nov 2026).
state.facts: The backend is built and released by codex. Commands: cmd_library_folders returns folders [{id,name,parentId?,assetCount}], assetFolders {assetId: folderId} and unfiledCount; assetCount is DIRECT children only, nested folders report their own. create(name, parentId?) returns the new id; rename; move(folderId, parentId or null); delete REFUSES a folder that has subfolders or assets (nothing can be lost); asset_move(assetId, folderId or null; null unfiles). Import folder is two steps: plan(directory) returns {rootName, folders, files[{relativePath, checksum, duplicate}], skipped, planFingerprint} and writes nothing; apply(directory, planFingerprint) rebuilds the plan, refuses if it differs, and returns the number of new assets; files whose content hash is already in the library are reported as duplicates and keep their placement. The Library panel today is a UiNode tree drawn for a person and an agent alike (one description, invariant 27): a Folders list with All assets, tabs, filter chips (All, This scene, Unused, Missing) with counts, a grid of cards, a selected-asset card. Figma B13 shows the Folders list with All assets 142, nested folders, Unfiled, an Import folder dialog. Owner rules: a control that does nothing is dimmed naming the row; a value shown must be one the app holds; the Editor already uses window.prompt for names (window.confirm does not work in the shell); the dock panel is narrow (about 270 px).
state.proposed: Folders list: All assets (count of all), then the folders nested with indentation and their direct count, then Unfiled (unfiledCount). Selecting one filters the cards. Buttons: + New folder (asks a name; inside the selected folder when one is selected), Rename and Delete on the selected folder, Import folder. The selected-asset card gets a Move to list (Unfiled and every folder). Import folder: pick a directory, show the plan in the panel (n files, d already in the library, skipped files named, the folders it will make) with Import n files and Cancel; nothing is written until Import.

folder_scope.instructions: When a folder is selected, which assets do the cards show?

criteria.A: Only the assets directly in it, so the number beside the folder equals the cards shown.
criteria.B: The assets in it and in all its subfolders, so the number beside it does not equal the cards shown.
criteria.C: Only the assets directly in it, but print the count of everything below it.

chip_counts.instructions: What do the filter chip counts (All, This scene, Unused, Missing) count while a folder is selected?

criteria.A: Only the assets in the selected folder scope, so the chips and the cards agree.
criteria.B: Always the whole library, so the chips and the cards can disagree.

moving.instructions: How does a designer put an asset into a folder?

criteria.A: A Move to list in the selected-asset card, one entry per folder and Unfiled: it works by keyboard and an agent reads the same entries.
criteria.B: Dragging a card onto a folder only.
criteria.C: Nothing yet: folders can be made but assets cannot be placed.

criteria.A: Runs it and shows the backend's refusal when the folder is not empty (nothing can be lost, so no confirm step).
criteria.B: Asks for a confirmation first, then deletes, moving any assets to Unfiled.
